sq.QUESTION_DESC: Give an example of responsible human conduct.

sq.ANSWER: When individuals act with fairness, cooperation, and respect, it builds trust and harmony in families, workplaces, and communities.
sq.QUESTION_DESC: How is human conduct connected to harmony in society?

lq.ANSWER: Ethical human conduct is definite because it is based on right understanding, natural acceptance and harmony at all levels. It is not dependent on time, place, person or situation. When a human being understands harmony in the Self, harmony with the Body, harmony in family, harmony in society and harmony with nature, the conduct becomes definite. Ethical conduct can be understood through values, policy and character. Values tell us what to do and what not to do as a human being. Policy gives the plan for how to live with those values. Character is the expression of those values in behaviour, work and participation. Therefore, ethical human conduct is self-satisfying, people-friendly and eco-friendly.
